text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss
- Credit Suisse chairman Rainer Gut's call to create a compensation fund for Holocaust victims was welcomed by both state and private organisations.

- EU transport Commissioner Neil Kinnock told journalists on Wednesday that he was concerned about the outcome of bilateral transport talks with Switzerland. Swiss negotiators did not move from their position to charge 600 francs for each 40 ton truck crossing the Swiss Alps.

- Alois Sonnenmoser was named chief executive of ABB Switzerland as from April 1, 1997. Sommermoser will replace Edwin Somm. - Alfred Defago, who is currently Swiss consul general in New York, may be appointed Ambassador to the U.S., sources said.

- Switzerland plans to allocate 720 million Swiss francs for an investment fund, which should revitalize Swiss economy. The government hopes the fund will generate other investments of about 1.8 billion francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
